sky.qualification: Ophelia's sky orientation for its camera; the shared universe draws the visible sky.
sky.sceneRegistrationChain: galactic -> ICRF (J2000 constants) -> body-fixed (IAU pole and prime meridian at the epoch) -> ecliptic presentation frame

provenance.source: JPL Uranus-system ephemeris; IAU Ophelia BODY707 from PCK00011 with the small periodic correction frozen at the prepared epoch.
provenance.qualification: Computed Ophelia Sun direction at 2026-09-03T00:00:00 TT, expressed in the ecliptic presentation frame (north up, Sun left at zero yaw) and in view space at the default camera pose.
